<title>UwU Hub Exposed</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link
  rel="stylesheet"
  href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@500;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Figtree:wght@400;600;800&display=swap"
/>
<style>
  /* ==========================================================================
     UwU Hub Exposed
     Layout: glassy hero + "OP" menu card, and an IDE-style source viewer
     that compares UwU Hub code with HollyScriptX / Moon Hub side by side.
     ========================================================================== */
  :root {
    --bg: #07060f;
    --card: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    --card2: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    --text: #f2eeff;
    --muted: #a79fd0;
    --a: #ff5fd2;
    --b: #6ee7ff;
    --alert: #ff3b5c;
    --warn: #ffd23f;
    --ai: #e8875f;
    --ide: #0d0b18;
    --display: "Unbounded", system-ui, sans-serif;
    --body: "Figtree", system-ui, sans-serif;
    --mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
  * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: var(--body);
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  button {
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: inherit;
  }
  :focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--warn);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  .orb {
    position: fixed;
    width: 520px;
    height: 520px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    filter: blur(110px);
    opacity: 0.26;
    z-index: -1;
    animation: fl 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .o1 {
    background: var(--a);
    top: -160px;
    left: -120px;
  }
  .o2 {
    background: var(--b);
    bottom: -180px;
    right: -140px;
    animation-delay: -6s;
  }
  .o3 {
    background: var(--alert);
    top: 40%;
    left: 55%;
    width: 340px;
    height: 340px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }
  @keyframes fl {
    to {
      transform: translate(80px, 60px) scale(1.15);
    }
  }

  nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    z-index: 5;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding-block: 14px;
    padding-left: max(5vw, 16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
    padding-right: max(5vw, 16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    background: rgba(7, 6, 15, 0.7);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  body::before {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0 0 auto;
    height: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    z-index: 10;
    background: var(--bg);
  }
  .brand {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 15px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--a), var(--b));
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    color: transparent;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  nav .links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }
  nav .links a {
    color: var(--muted);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  nav .links a:hover {
    color: var(--text);
  }
  main {
    max-width: 1040px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-block: 0 70px;
    padding-left: max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
    padding-right: max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  }

  .hero {
    text-align: center;
    padding-block: 64px 30px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  h1 {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 7.5vw, 4.6rem);
    line-height: 1.02;
    margin: 0;
    text-wrap: balance;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  h1 .g {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--a), var(--b), var(--a));
    background-size: 200%;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    color: transparent;
    animation: sh 6s linear infinite;
  }
  h1 s {
    text-decoration-color: var(--alert);
    text-decoration-thickness: 0.09em;
    color: var(--muted);
  }
  @keyframes sh {
    to {
      background-position: 200%;
    }
  }
  .sub {
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 1.12rem;
    max-width: 600px;
    margin: 0;
  }
  .sub b {
    color: var(--text);
  }
  .chips {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .chip {
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 99px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--card);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--b);
  }
  .chip.red {
    color: var(--alert);
    border-color: rgba(255, 59, 92, 0.35);
  }
  .cta {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--card2);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 15px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: 0.2s;
  }
  .btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--a);
  }
  .btn.p {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--a), #b76cff);
    border-color: transparent;
    color: #14061a;
    font-weight: 800;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(255, 95, 210, 0.25);
  }
  .btn.p:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }
  .btn.sm {
    padding: 6px 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
    border-radius: 9px;
  }


  h2 {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 3.4vw, 1.8rem);
    margin: 64px 0 6px;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  .card {
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 22px;
    padding: 24px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    transition: 0.25s;
  }

  .hub {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 1fr;
    gap: 26px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .shot {
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    cursor: zoom-in;
    display: block;
    padding: 0;
    background: none;
  }
  .shot img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }
  .stamp {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-12deg);
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: clamp(28px, 6vw, 56px);
    color: var(--alert);
    border: 6px solid var(--alert);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 4px 18px;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    background: rgba(7, 6, 15, 0.35);
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 59, 92, 0.5);
  }
  .zoom {
    position: absolute;
    right: 10px;
    bottom: 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    background: rgba(7, 6, 15, 0.75);
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 99px;
    color: var(--muted);
  }
  .hub h3 {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin: 0;
  }
  .hub p {
    color: var(--muted);
    margin: 8px 0 14px;
  }
  .feat {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .feat i {
    font-style: normal;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--card2);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }


  /* arrow */
  .arrow {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(255, 59, 92, 0.45));
  }
  .arrow.ai {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(232, 135, 95, 0.4));
  }
  .arrow .lbl {
    background: var(--alert);
    color: #fff;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    padding: 7px 10px 7px 12px;
    border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .arrow .tip {
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    border-top: 16px solid transparent;
    border-bottom: 16px solid transparent;
    border-left: 18px solid var(--alert);
  }
  .arrow.left {
    flex-direction: row-reverse;
  }
  .arrow.left .tip {
    border-left: 0;
    border-right: 18px solid var(--alert);
  }
  .arrow.left .lbl {
    border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  }
  .arrow.ai .lbl {
    background: var(--ai);
    color: #1d0b04;
  }
  .arrow.ai .tip {
    border-left-color: var(--ai);
  }
  .arrow.ai.left .tip {
    border-right-color: var(--ai);
    border-left-color: transparent;
  }
  .arrow.ai.down .tip {
    border-top-color: var(--ai);
    border-left-color: transparent;
  }
  .arrow.bob {
    animation: bob 1s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes bob {
    50% {
      transform: translateX(-6px);
    }
  }

  /* modals */
  .modal {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 30;
    background: rgba(3, 2, 8, 0.78);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)) max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px))
      calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
  }
  .imgbox {
    position: relative;
    max-width: 1000px;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .imgbox img {
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .x {
    position: absolute;
    top: -14px;
    right: -6px;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--ide);
    font-size: 20px;
  }
  .ide {
    width: min(1180px, 100%);
    height: min(88vh, 900px);
    background: var(--ide);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 16px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  }
  .bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .dots {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .dots u {
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #ff5f57;
  }
  .dots u:nth-child(2) {
    background: #febc2e;
  }
  .dots u:nth-child(3) {
    background: #28c840;
  }
  .fn {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-right: auto;
  }
  .fn b {
    color: var(--text);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr);
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .sidebar {
    border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    overflow: auto;
  }
  .sidebar h4 {
    margin: 4px 6px 4px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--muted);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .st {
    text-align: left;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 9px 10px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1px;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  .st small {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--alert);
  }
  .st.full small {
    color: var(--muted);
  }
  .st:hover {
    background: var(--card);
  }
  .st[aria-selected="true"] {
    background: var(--card2);
    border-color: var(--a);
  }
  .codewrap {
    position: relative;
    padding-right: 10px;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .banner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: rgba(255, 59, 92, 0.07);
  }
  .banner p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 200px;
  }
  .banner p b {
    color: var(--text);
  }
  .code {
    flex: 1;
    overflow: auto;
    tab-size: 3;
    -moz-tab-size: 3;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 12.5px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    counter-reset: ln;
    position: relative;
    padding-block: 8px;
  }
  .code .l {
    display: block;
    white-space: pre;
    padding-right: 24px;
    min-width: max-content;
  }
  .code .l::before {
    counter-increment: ln;
    content: attr(data-n);
    display: inline-block;
    width: 5.2em;
    padding-right: 1.2em;
    text-align: right;
    color: #4d4470;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .code.wrap .l {
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    min-width: 0;
    padding-left: 6.4em;
    text-indent: -6.4em;
  }
  .code .l.hot {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 59, 92, 0.22), rgba(255, 59, 92, 0.04));
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--alert);
  }
  .code .l.hot.start::after {
    content: "  ◀ SKIDDED CHUNK START";
    color: var(--alert);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .code .l.hot.end::after {
    content: "  ◀ end of skidded chunk";
    color: var(--alert);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }
  .code .l.ai {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(232, 135, 95, 0.2), rgba(232, 135, 95, 0.03));
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--ai);
  }
  .code .l.ai::after {
    content: "  ◀ 🤖 USELESS CODE ADDED BY CLAUDE";
    color: var(--ai);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .skid.ai .from,
  .st.ai small {
    color: var(--ai);
  }
  .mini {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 10px;
    border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    z-index: 3;
  }
  .mini a {
    position: absolute;
    right: 0;
    width: 10px;
    min-height: 3px;
    background: var(--alert);
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .mini a.ai {
    background: var(--ai);
  }
  .jump {
    margin-left: auto;
  }
  .code .gap {
    color: #6b6390;
    font-style: italic;
    padding: 6px 0 6px 6.4em;
    display: block;
  }
  .code .float {
    position: absolute;
    right: 16px;
    z-index: 2;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
  }
  .k {
    color: #ff86e0;
  }
  .s {
    color: #ffd98a;
  }
  .n {
    color: #8fe3ff;
  }
  .c {
    color: #6b6390;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .g {
    color: #9ef0c1;
  }
  .f {
    color: #b9a6ff;
  }
  .foot {
    padding: 7px 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  /* loader */
  #loader {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 50;
    background: var(--bg);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 24px;
    transition: opacity 0.5s;
  }
  #loader.done {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .lbox {
    width: min(520px, 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .lbox .brand {
    font-size: 28px;
  }
  .lmsg {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 14px;
    min-height: 2.6em;
  }
  .lbar {
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 99px;
    background: var(--card2);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .lbar i {
    display: block;
    height: 100%;
    width: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--a), var(--b));
    transition: width 0.25s;
    border-radius: 99px;
  }
  .llog {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    height: 8em;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }
  .llog .bad {
    color: var(--alert);
  }
  .skip {
    align-self: flex-start;
  }

  /* toasts */
  #toasts {
    position: fixed;
    right: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
    bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    z-index: 60;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
    gap: 10px;
    width: min(330px, calc(100vw - 32px));
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .toast {
    pointer-events: auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
    align-items: start;
    background: rgba(20, 16, 36, 0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 11px 13px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    animation: in 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.3, 0.4, 1);
  }
  .toast .ic {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--a), var(--b));
  }
  .toast.bad .ic {
    background: var(--alert);
  }
  .toast b {
    display: block;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .toast span {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
  }
  .toast.out {
    animation: out 0.3s forwards;
  }
  @keyframes in {
    from {
      transform: translateX(40px) scale(0.95);
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }
  @keyframes out {
    to {
      transform: translateX(40px);
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }

  /* compare panes */
  .panes {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .panes.split {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .pane {
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .pane.orig {
    border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: rgba(110, 231, 255, 0.025);
  }
  .phead {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--muted);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .phead b {
    color: var(--text);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .phead .pill {
    padding: 1px 8px;
    border-radius: 99px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }
  .pill.uwu {
    background: rgba(255, 59, 92, 0.15);
    color: var(--alert);
  }
  .pill.hsx {
    background: rgba(255, 95, 210, 0.15);
    color: var(--a);
  }
  .pill.moon {
    background: rgba(110, 231, 255, 0.15);
    color: var(--b);
  }
  .code .l.twin {
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .code .l.twin:not(.start):not(.end)::after {
    content: "  ⇄ match";
    color: var(--b);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .code .l.orighot {

<script type="module">
  // Page data (source code, flagged sections, screenshot) lives in the JSON block at the bottom of the file.
  const DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("page-data").textContent);
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-shot]").forEach((img) => (img.src = DATA.shot));
  const SRC = DATA.source,
    LINES = SRC.split("\n");
  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
  const esc = (s) => s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");

  /* Lua highlighter (line-based so every line stays its own row) */
  const KW = new Set(
    "and break do else elseif end false for function goto if in local nil not or repeat return then true until while continue".split(
      " ",
    ),
  );
  const GL = new Set(
    "game workspace script print warn error pcall xpcall spawn task wait require typeof type tostring tonumber pairs ipairs next select setmetatable getmetatable loadstring getgenv getfenv setfenv Instance Vector3 CFrame Color3 UDim2 Enum string table math os coroutine bit32 debug getgc filtergc hookfunction".split(
      " ",
    ),
  );
  const RE =
    /(--[^\n]*)|("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*')|(\b0[xX][\da-fA-F]+\b|\b\d+\.?\d*(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?\b)|([A-Za-z_]\w*)/g;
  function hl(line) {
    let out = "",
      last = 0,
      m;
    RE.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((m = RE.exec(line))) {
      out += esc(line.slice(last, m.index));
      last = RE.lastIndex;
      const t = m[0];
      if (m[1]) out += '<span class="c">' + esc(t) + "</span>";
      else if (m[2]) out += '<span class="s">' + esc(t) + "</span>";
      else if (m[3]) out += '<span class="n">' + t + "</span>";
      else if (KW.has(t)) out += '<span class="k">' + t + "</span>";
      else if (GL.has(t)) out += '<span class="g">' + t + "</span>";
      else if (/^\s*[({"']/.test(line.slice(last))) out += '<span class="f">' + t + "</span>";
      else out += t;
    }
    return out + esc(line.slice(last));
  }
  const HL = LINES.map(hl); // ~14k lines, cheap enough once

  function arrow(cls, ai) {
    return `<span class="arrow ${cls || ""}"><span class="lbl">${ai ? "USELESS CODE ADDED BY CLAUDE" : "SKIDDED CODE ALERT"}</span><span class="tip"></span></span>`;
  }

  /* sidebar, grouped by who it was taken from */
  const sb = $("#sidebar");
  sb.innerHTML = "";
  const GROUPS = [
    ["hsx", "Skidded from HollyScriptX"],
    ["moon", "Skidded from Moon Hub"],
    ["claude", "Useless code added by Claude"],
  ];
  GROUPS.forEach(([k, label]) => {
    const list = DATA.sections.filter((s) => s.src === k);
    if (!list.length) return;
    const h = document.createElement("h4");
    h.className = "grp";
    h.textContent = label;
    sb.appendChild(h);
    list.forEach((s) => {
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.className = "st" + (k === "claude" ? " ai" : "");
      b.role = "tab";
      b.dataset.id = s.id;
      const n = s.hot.length;
      b.innerHTML = `<small class="${k}">${k === "claude" ? n + " lines flagged" : n + " lines · " + s.twins.length + " matches"}</small>${esc(s.title)}`;
      b.onclick = () => view(s.id);
      sb.appendChild(b);
    });
  });
  {
    const h = document.createElement("h4");
    h.className = "grp";
    h.textContent = "Everything";
    sb.appendChild(h);
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "st full";
    b.role = "tab";
    b.dataset.id = "full";
    b.innerHTML = `<small>${LINES.length.toLocaleString()} lines</small>Full source`;
    b.onclick = () => view("full");
    sb.appendChild(b);
  }

  /* marks: skid chunks flag every line, Claude flags only its exact lines */
  const MARK = new Map(),
    TWIN = new Map();
  DATA.sections.forEach((s) => {
    if (s.src === "claude") {
      s.hot.forEach((n) => MARK.set(n, "ai"));
      return;
    }
    s.ranges.forEach(([a, b]) => {

  $("#appeal").onclick = () => {
    $("#appeal").textContent = "📨 Appeal denied (instantly)";
    toast("UwU Bot", "Appeal reviewed by the owner's alt. Denied.", "🤖", true);
  };

  /* title clicks achievement */
  let tc = 0;
  $("#title").onclick = () => {
    tc++;
    if (tc >= 5) {
      tc = 0;
      confetti();
      toast("Achievement unlocked", "Certified UwU Paster 🏆", "🏆");
    } else toast("UwU Hub", `${5 - tc} more clicks to become a skid…`, "👆");
  };

  /* type "uwu" anywhere → uwu mode */
  let typed = "";
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest("input,textarea")) return;
    typed = (typed + e.key.toLowerCase()).slice(-3);
    if (typed === "uwu") {
      const on = document.body.classList.toggle("uwu");
      if (on) {
        document.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,.sub,.skid p,.rot").forEach((el) => {
          el.dataset.orig = el.dataset.orig || el.innerHTML;
          el.innerHTML = el.innerHTML.replace(
            />([^<]+)</g,
            (m, s) => ">" + s.replace(/[rl]/g, "w").replace(/[RL]/g, "W") + "<",
          );
        });
        toast("UwU mode", "owo what's this? evewything is skidded now", "🐱");
        confetti(["🐱", "uwu", "owo", "💖"]);
      } else {
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-orig]").forEach((el) => (el.innerHTML = el.dataset.orig));
        toast("UwU mode", "Back to normal. The code is still stolen.", "🐱");
      }
    }
    if (
      e.key === "F12" ||
      (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && ["I", "J", "C"].includes(e.key.toUpperCase())) ||
      (e.ctrlKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "u")
    )
      toast(
        "DevTools",
        "Bro is about to deobfuscate UwU Hub. Nothing original inside, don't bother.",
        "🕵️",
        true,
      );
  });

  /* right click / copy */
  document.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    toast("Inspect element?", "You'd only find Moon Hub's code in there.", "🚫", true);
  });
  let selfCopy = false;
  ["#copy"].forEach((s) =>
    $(s).addEventListener(
      "click",
      () => {
        selfCopy = true;
        setTimeout(() => (selfCopy = false), 200);
      },
      true,
    ),
  );
  document.addEventListener("copy", () => {
    if (!selfCopy) toast("Copying?", "Careful, that's how UwU Hub got started.", "📋");
  });

  /* tab title troll */
  const realTitle = document.title;
  let tt;
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    clearInterval(tt);
    if (document.hidden) {
      const m = [
        "📋 come back skid",
        "🐱 uwu?",
        "🚨 ultra detected",
        "📋 pasting…",
        "🤡 imagine leaving",
      ];
      let k = 0;
      tt = setInterval(() => (document.title = m[k++ % m.length]), 1000);
    } else {
      document.title = realTitle;
      toast("UwU Hub", "Welcome back. We pasted 3 new features while you were gone.", "👀");
    }
  });

  /* cookie banner with a decline button that runs */
  const decReady = runaway(
    $("#cDec"),
    ["🏃 no", "🍪 too slow", "nice try"],
    () => ($("#cDec").textContent = "Accept"),
  );
  const cookieBack = () =>
    setTimeout(() => {
      $("#cookie").classList.remove("gone");
      toast("Cookies", "Your cookies were skidded. Please accept again.", "🍪");
    }, 40000);
  $("#cAcc").onclick = () => {
    $("#cookie").classList.add("gone");
    toast("Cookies", "Accepted. They're Moon Hub's cookies now.", "🍪");
    cookieBack();
    setChat();
  };
  $("#cDec").onclick = () => {
    if (!decReady()) return;
    $("#cookie").classList.add("gone");
    toast(
      "Cookies",
      "We turned your Decline into Accept. Just like UwU turned Moon into UwU.",
      "🍪",
    );
    cookieBack();
    setChat();
  };

  /* fake support chat (shows once cookie banner is gone so they don't overlap) */
  const CHAT = [
    "hi! how can I paste for you today? 😊",
    "our devs are very busy renaming variables",
    "have you tried Moon Hub? same thing tbh",
    "pls don't ask who wrote the arcade farm",
    "new update: we changed the logo color",
    "ur ban appeal is in the trash folder ♻️",
  ];
  let ci = 0,
    chatOn = false;
  function setChat() {
    if (chatOn) return;
    chatOn = true;
    setTimeout(function loop() {
      const c = $("#chat");
      if ($("#cookie").classList.contains("gone")) {
        $("#chatText").textContent = CHAT[ci++ % CHAT.length];
        c.classList.add("on");
        bonk(660, 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => c.classList.remove("on"), 4200);
      }
      setTimeout(loop, 14000);
    }, 3000);
  }

  /* extra dynamic notifications */
  const PLACES = ["Ohio", "Texas", "London", "Berlin", "Toronto", "Manila", "São Paulo", "Sydney"];
  const DYN = [
    () => ["UwU Hub", `Someone in ${rand(PLACES)} just pasted Moon Hub and called it V3`, "🔔"],
    () => [
      "UwU Hub",
      `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 80) + 10} skids got banned in the last hour`,
      "🔨",
      1,
    ],
    () => ["UwU Hub", "Brain cells used to make this hub: 2", "🧠"],
    () => ["UwU Hub", "@everyone new feature dropped (we found it on GitHub)", "📢"],
    () => ["Executor", "UwU Hub crashed. Original code not found.", "💥", 1],
  ];
  setInterval(() => {
    if (document.hidden) return;
    const d = rand(DYN)();
    toast(d[0], d[1], d[2], d[3]);
  }, 11000);
</script>
